vite_bundle_size_check.limitations: Scientific visualization packages (Three.js, R3F) are dynamically code-split into AppShell.

assertions: Closed-loop from real EEG is disabled by default.
The corridor is not a decoded mental image. It is an adaptive scaffold driven by experimental proxy metrics.
IMAGINA outputs are experimental imagery proxy artifacts, not decoded thoughts or dreams.
Static evidence is a baked snapshot, not live runtime evidence.
Physical OpenBCI/Galea validation remains unperformed unless a real device report exists.

screenshot_asset_check.notes: Expected screenshot filenames are fully registered and mapped in docs/SCREENSHOT_AND_DEMO_ASSETS.md.

verifiable_limitations: No active live EEG closed-loop adaptions are permitted.
Hardware Cyton/Ganglion validation is synthetic only.
All outputs represent statistical correlation proxy mappings.
